prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for a digital creative portfolio, NOT a website mockup.
Primary request: Create one precise 4 column by 2 row contact sheet, EIGHT EQUAL RECTANGULAR FRAMES in reading order of ONE loopable side-view walking cycle of the SAME young adult man in an oversized hoodie, hood up, relaxed streetwear trousers, sneakers, and WHITE WIRED EARBUDS. Full body, facing RIGHT. This is a PURE BLACK FEATURELESS SILHOUETTE, the only internal detail is the delicate white earbud cable from his ear to his hoodie pocket.
Reference style: the user supplied early iPod silhouette campaign moodboards and vivid Great Pretender anime color moodboards. Take the flat graphic silhouette clarity of the former with the cool urban attitude of the latter. NO Apple logos, no iPod, no anime face.
Composition: 4 columns and 2 rows, perfectly evenly sized, edge to edge, NO gutters or margins, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text. Overall image landscape 2048 by 1280 if possible, every cell 512 by 640, portrait 4:5. Each frame has the identical solid bright CYAN #08bce9 background. Each frame shows the full figure centered at the exact SAME x coordinate and exact SAME scale with the feet on the same ground baseline at 91 percent height. Figure fills about 78 percent of cell height with clear headroom and no clipping.
Animation: eight distinct sequential natural WALK CYCLE phases from left foot forward contact through passing to right foot forward contact through passing back to first pose. Arms swing naturally opposite legs. White earbud cable follows movement. Keep torso, head, hoodie silhouette, body proportions, cable, camera, background and baseline completely consistent. Eight varied leg and arm positions; no duplicate poses. The man walks in place for an animated gif, never moving horizontally between frames.
Style: exceptionally clean bold graphic flat screenprinted silhouettes, crisp edges, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no photography, no 3D. Black figure on flat electric cyan. Do not draw shadows, floor, buildings, props, devices, text or symbols.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: three-panel illustration art for a digital creative portfolio website. ONLY ARTWORK, NO WEBSITE MOCKUP.
Primary request: a bold, exceptionally clean, flat graphic triptych of THREE equally wide vertical panels side by side, no borders or gutters. Overall wide landscape canvas, 3:1 aspect ratio if possible. Every panel is a square crop. All objects and all people are PURE SOLID BLACK silhouettes with absolutely no faces, no shading or internal details. Only thin white wired earbud cables and white code glyphs may be white.
Panel 1, left third: vivid solid hot pink #f347a0 background. Side view of a young man in a hoodie hunched slightly forward programming at a laptop on a desk, seated on an office stool. Hands clearly at keyboard. He wears white WIRED earbuds. Black silhouette torso, arms, laptop, desk, chair. Crop creative composition: figure on right half of its panel facing left, laptop on left half. Sparse floating small black code brackets in upper left. Leave top 12% and bottom 10% clean empty pink.
Panel 2, middle third: vivid solid acid lime #c1ee3e background. A young man with hood UP in profile facing LEFT, shoulders and head in the lower right of its panel, clearly featureless SOLID BLACK silhouette. Above his open upturned silhouetted hand hovers a graphic BLACK abstract AI neural network made of six simple orbiting spherical black nodes with thin black connecting lines, and a single central asterisk/spark shape. His extended hand reaches toward the network from lower right toward upper left. White earbud cable. This is a silhouette editorial poster, not a realistic sci-fi illustration. Leave top 12% and bottom 10% empty lime.
Panel 3, right third: vivid solid golden YELLOW #ffc331 background. Urban Amsterdam-meets-Tokyo rooftops and building silhouettes, utility cables, single antenna and slender towers, all SOLID BLACK FLAT SHAPES, city on lower two thirds of panel. Rooftops form a strong staggered horizon line. Tiny hoodie-wearing walking man in silhouette on a foreground rooftop toward right. Simple large BLACK disk sun in the upper right quadrant partially behind a building. Leave top 12% and bottom 10% empty yellow.
Style references: early iPod campaign pure black silhouette posters with loud flat cyan/magenta/lime/yellow fields; Great Pretender anime graphic compositions and urban creative energy; subtle cyberpunk attitude but ZERO glowing neon or digital gradients. Clean screenprint graphic silhouettes.
Critical constraints: exactly THREE equal-width panels, no fourth panel, flat untextured color fields, true featureless black silhouettes, no grey or color inside silhouettes, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no photorealism, no painted details. Strong simple readable shapes at thumbnail size. Keep colors very vivid.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: four-panel graphic illustration strip, art only, for animated digital creative portfolio scenes.
Primary request: ONE wide 4:1 landscape graphic consisting of EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL SQUARE PANELS edge-to-edge, no gutters, no borders. Suggested overall resolution 3072x768. Every person and every object is PURE FEATURELESS SOLID BLACK SILHOUETTE on a VIVID FLAT SOLID COLOR. These are the same young adult male digital creative, messy short hair, oversized hoodie, white wired earbuds, creative streetwear.
LEFT panel 1: solid electric BLUE #4163ff. Side view of hoodied man wearing earbuds making music on a compact synth keyboard or mixing console. The silhouetted creative is seated on right facing left, synth on left. Several simple black soundwave arcs floating above the synth. Strong uncluttered composition.
Panel 2: solid electric PURPLE #a376ff. Hoodied young man facing left, standing at a digital drawing tablet on a small tall desk, hand holding stylus, designing. Around the tablet float a simple black hollow circle and black triangle, graphic creativity. White earbud cable. Pure black shapes.
Panel 3: solid vivid ORANGE #ff812c. Hood UP young man crouched in profile facing right, exploring an impossible floating black cube with his outstretched hand. Three small black geometric shapes orbit the cube. Black silhouette, white wired earbuds. Digital experimentation.
RIGHT panel 4: solid vivid vermilion RED #ff4744. Hoodied young man in profile facing left sitting casually cross-legged on a low block, drawing or writing in a notebook on his knee, stylus in hand, head looking down. White wired earbuds. Above him three simple black sparks indicating ideas. Strong graphic silhouette.
Composition: square panels; full scene centered inside middle 80% width and middle 70% height of EACH panel. Leave the top 12% and bottom 10% of each panel relatively clear for website overlay labels. No edge clipping of heads. Single clean male figure per panel. Strong pose readable at small size.
Style: early iPod silhouette poster campaign meets Great Pretender anime color blocking. Strict FLAT BLACK silhouette art, no faces, no eyes, no skin, no interior detail, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no shadows. Backgrounds must stay loud blue, purple, orange and red. Pure black, thin white earbud cables, four flat background colors only. No written words, no typography, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no screens with UI, no website mockup.
